AboutPage.title: About Us
AboutPage.OurStory_p1_part1: We aren't just another real estate portal;
AboutPage.OurStory_p1_bold: we are your neighbors in Hungary
AboutPage.OurStory_p1_part2: Many of you already know us through
AboutPage.OurStory_p1_part3: where we've built a reputation for providing honest and reliable information to the expat community.
AboutPage.OurStory_p2: Ungarn-Immo was born out of a shared frustration: the traditional real estate market in Hungary often lacks the transparency that international buyers desperately need. We've seen too many "polished" photos that hide serious defects and too many buyers left alone with complex legal processes.
AboutPage.FairShare_p1: We decided to flip the script. Instead of high brokerage commissions that often reach 3-5% plus VAT, we operate on a Fair-Share Principle.
AboutPage.FairShare_p2: We do not charge traditional commissions. Instead, both the buyer and seller contribute a 0.5% donation (1% total), but covered by a maximum, to a local Hungarian social project. This ensures that every transaction leaves a positive footprint in your new home.
AboutPage.RadicalHonesty_p1: We believe that a new life in a new country must start with the truth. That's why we require every seller to provide unedited video tours of the house and the surrounding village.
AboutPage.RadicalHonesty_p2: Our platform uses AI to translate communication in real-time, bridging the gap between local sellers and international buyers. We don't just sell houses; we provide the context of the village—the social structure, the infrastructure, and the feeling of the community.
AboutPage.OurSupport_title: A Technical Companion for Your Move
AboutPage.TechMeetsHuman_p1: By combining human experience with advanced technology, we ensure your move is safe. From AI-driven document preparation to a vetted network of partners, we are here to support you every step of the way.
AboutPage.TechMeetsHuman_p2: We are the "helpful team from next door," using modern tools to bring people together fairly.
AboutPage.UneditedTours_description: Every property includes authentic video tours showing the house and surrounding village exactly as they are.
AboutPage.AITranslation_description: Our platform breaks down language barriers, connecting international buyers with local sellers seamlessly.
AboutPage.VillageContext_description: We provide insights into the social structure, infrastructure, and community feeling of each location.

ServicesPage.title: Our Services
ServicesPage.Hero_title: A Unique Platform Tailored for Expats
ServicesPage.Hero_description: Our primary goal is to provide a real estate experience specifically designed for the needs of those moving to Hungary. We remove the barriers of language, distance, and lack of local knowledge.
ServicesPage.TranslationChat_short: Communication is often the biggest hurdle. Our Matrix-based chat translates your messages instantly between HU, DE, and EN.
ServicesPage.TranslationChat_full: We archive all communication for 10 years to provide a secure record for both parties in case of disputes.
ServicesPage.PartnerNetwork_short: Finding reliable lawyers, translators, or craftsmen is difficult. Our network consists of professionals recommended by our community and internally rated by our team.
ServicesPage.PartnerNetwork_full: Only the highest-rated partners stay on the platform.
ServicesPage.VillagePortraits_short: No more "surprises" during viewings. Every listing must include a standardized video tour showing the house, the street, and the village infrastructure.
ServicesPage.FairShare_short: We replace commissions with social impact.
ServicesPage.FairShare_full: A 0.5% contribution from each side goes directly to a verified social project.
ServicesPage.AIAssistant_short: We help you prepare all necessary data for the lawyer. Our AI checks your documents for consistency and completeness.
ServicesPage.AIAssistant_full: making the legal process faster and safer.

ForBuyersPage.title: For Buyers
ForBuyersPage.Hero_title: Your Roadmap to Buying Property in Hungary
ForBuyersPage.Hero_description: Moving to a new country is a huge step, and the property market in Hungary has its own rules. At Ungarn-Immo, we guide you through every phase to ensure you aren't just buying a house, but finding a home.
ForBuyersPage.Step1_short: Standard portals show you rooms and prices. We show you what matters for your life.
ForBuyersPage.Step1_full: Use our specialized filters to find homes based on Internet quality (fiber/DSL), proximity to German or English-speaking doctors, and the strength of the local international community. Our "Expat-Compass" helps you identify villages that match your lifestyle, whether you are a Digital Nomad, a young family, or a retiree.
ForBuyersPage.Step2_short: Before you book a flight, watch the mandatory House and Village Videos. We encourage sellers to show everything—including the cracks and the old windows.
ForBuyersPage.Step2_full: If you want a closer look, you can request a Live-Video Besichtigung, where the seller walks through the house with you via our integrated video chat.
ForBuyersPage.Step3_short: In Hungary, a lawyer is mandatory for the property purchase contract. Our platform generates a Draft Contract based on the verified data in the listing.
ForBuyersPage.Step3_full: which you can then hand over to a lawyer from our vetted partner network. This ensures all parties are on the same page from day one.
ForBuyersPage.Step4_short: Once the deal is signed, you pay your 0.5% Fair-Share donation directly to a verified social project.
ForBuyersPage.Step4_full: Only after this donation is confirmed do we release the final completion documents to both parties. For more in-depth information on taxes, residency (Lakcímkártya), and utility registration, check out our expert articles on wir-in-ungarn.hu.

ForSellersPage.title: For Sellers
ForSellersPage.Hero_title: Selling with Integrity: Reach the Right Buyers
ForSellersPage.Hero_description: Whether you are a private homeowner or a municipal representative, Ungarn-Immo offers you a direct line to a motivated international audience without the cost of a middleman.
ForSellersPage.Honesty_short: Why describe defects? Because buyers are looking for a project they can trust. By being honest about renovation needs, you filter out "viewing tourists" and attract serious buyers who are prepared for the work.
ForSellersPage.Honesty_full: Transparency is your fastest path to a successful closing.
ForSellersPage.NoCommission_short: Stop paying 3–5% commission to traditional brokers. On Ungarn-Immo, listing is free.
ForSellersPage.NoCommission_full: Your only obligation is the 0.5% Fair-Share donation upon a successful sale, which helps revitalize the very community your house is part of.
ForSellersPage.Municipalities_short: With the upcoming legal changes in 2025 regarding heirless properties, many villages will find themselves responsible for vacant homes.
ForSellersPage.Municipalities_full: We offer a specialized onboarding process for municipalities to list these properties, helping to bring new life, families, and investment back into rural Hungary.
ForSellersPage.Tools_description: Our Seller Dashboard gives you everything you need:
ForSellersPage.Tool1_description: We pull public data for your village; you just answer a few questions, and our AI writes a professional village portrait.
ForSellersPage.Tool2_description: For a small fee (5,000–10,000 HUF), our AI service will subtitle and translate your house videos into German and Hungarian.
